objective: Connect existing exact finite-box root discovery and independent complete-cover verification to the root Rust API, typed Session and interactive NDJSON CLI.

behavior.accepted_empty_result: A zero-root result requires independent verification of a complete exclusion cover.
behavior.unresolved_result: Unresolved, singular, outer-boundary, invalid-domain and exhausted-resource cases never publish a successful partial root set.
behavior.implementation: Reuse fsym-calculus exact subdivision and fsym-core independent original-source complete-cover checking. No new mathematical engine, dependency or changed precision/budget default.
behavior.budgets: Search spends ordinary compute. Complete-cover acceptance spends protected verifier compute. Memory and allocations use the same cumulative ledger; retries and failures retain performed work.
behavior.publication: Validate every derived child label, collision, aggregate capacity and complete response/resource admission before publishing either the immutable isolation receipt or child handles.
behavior.storage: Child certificates hold parent-isolation/index references, avoiding deep copies of retained source/witness forests.
behavior.portability: Every accepted child root uses existing canonical local-root export and fresh-session independent replay. The complete coverage receipt is currently in-process only.

validation.scope: Actual root library, CLI and six integration-test files compiled afresh against cached production mathematical dependencies and a separately named synchronous runtime validation crate. That crate references unchanged production workspace, protocol, publication, fmap and replay modules. Full production fsym-runtime/asupersync was not compiled by this scoped run.
validation.execution: Pinned rustc and clippy-driver were invoked directly with the recorded Cargo dependency closure because the overlay was full. Temporary source and outputs were staged in a persistent executor's private /dev filesystem. No mocked functions, replacement mathematics, changed pins or relaxed warnings were used.

dependency_provenance.concurrent_change_not_rebuilt: 0bca4943e902b6998ea5bf21ff89accadd5f2567 adds inverse-circular compiled-program operations in fsym-calculus and was preserved as the Session commit parent. These changed compiled-program paths are outside the original-source isolation path exercised here. This record does not claim the cached binaries validate those new operations.

validation.compiler_result: Root library, actual CLI and all six integration targets compiled successfully; every observed exit code was zero.
validation.test_exit_codes: All six test executables exited zero.

strict_clippy.invocation: Pinned clippy-driver on the same actual sources and dependency closure, with -Dwarnings --emit=metadata.

formatting.scope: Changed Rust source and integration tests

observed_cases: Both irrational roots of x^2-2 and all four roots of a coupled two-dimensional system, checked against independent exact expectations.
Explicit coordinate order, source freezing despite later workspace bindings, and complete root-free exclusion.
Missing cover cells, overlapping or forged covers, source/domain substitution, original poles hidden by zero products or cancellation.
Singular and outer-boundary roots, subdivision exhaustion and invalid precision, shape or wire inputs.
Cumulative ordinary/protected fuel separation and typed cancellation at first, middle and last observed successful-path checkpoints.
A late child-ID collision and ordinary output exhaustion after complete protected verification publish neither parent nor child objects.
Actual stdin-open CLI at default limits discovers both roots, exports both children and independently replays them in fresh processes.

full_workspace.detail: The prior pinned full-workspace checks were killed while compiling unchanged asupersync under the shared memory limit. This continuation used the explicitly scoped cached closure; full-workspace check, Clippy, tests and Python-extension execution are not claimed. The execution environment became unavailable after both feature commits had been tested and remotely verified.

measured_x_squared_minus_two_session.interpretation: Observed logical cumulative counters for the focused registration/isolation example; not a performance benchmark.

independent_review.scope: Native generator/verifier separation, Session budget ownership, child-reference lifetime, capacities, collision checks, wire boundaries and publication atomicity.
independent_review.result: No blocking correctness or acceptance issue found in the bounded source review.

remote_verification.feature_commits: Both exact commit objects, messages, changed paths and final relevant source blobs were independently fetched after connector writes to main.
remote_verification.later_change: One descendant commit adds sparse least-squares consumer/Python support and README/CI additions. A read-only comparison confirmed the isolation source, tests and validation dependency closure were unchanged.

limitations: The bounded successful receipt proves completeness only in its declared finite closed box and requires certifiable nonsingular roots.
Portable export/replay of the entire complete-cover or zero-root proof was designed and source-reviewed but not applied, compiled, tested or committed before environment loss.
No complete runtime lifecycle, asynchronous cancellation, persistence, repair, Python compatibility profile or full integration campaign is validated by this scoped run.
No comparative performance or profile/campaign completion claim is made.
